def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Simple pursuit: turn toward enemy and go forward
    bearing = me.bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)  # degrees, -180..180
    dist = me.distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)

    # Turn rate proportional to bearing
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, bearing / 45.0))  # full turn at 45 deg error
    # Forward throttle reduced when far away to avoid overshoot
    forward = 1.0 if dist > 1.0 else 0.5

    left = forward + turn
    right = forward - turn
    # Clamp
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)


def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    cmds = []
    flipper = me.weapons.get("front")
    if flipper and flipper["type"] == "flipper" and flipper.get("ready", False):
        bearing = me.bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
        dist = me.distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
        # Fire when roughly facing enemy and within range
        if abs(bearing) < 30 and dist < 1.5:
            cmds.append(flip("front"))
    return cmds

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Global helpers bearing_to and distance_to are available
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)          # degrees -180..180
    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)

    # Turn proportionally to bearing
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, bearing / 45.0))

    # Forward throttle: full when far, reduced when very close to avoid overshoot
    forward = 1.0 if dist > 1.2 else 0.6

    left = forward + turn
    right = forward - turn
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)


def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    cmds = []
    lifter = me.weapons.get("front")
    if lifter and lifter["type"] == "lifter":
        # Lifter state: "down" when ready to lift, "up" while raised
        state = lifter.get("state", "down")
        bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
        dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)

        # Try to lift when we are roughly facing the enemy, close enough,
        # and the lifter is down (ready)
        if state == "down" and abs(bearing) < 25 and dist < 1.0:
            cmds.append(lift("front"))
        # If we have lifted and the enemy is no longer over the forks,
        # lower the lifter to reset
        elif state == "up" and (abs(bearing) > 30 or dist > 1.5):
            cmds.append(lower("front"))
    return cmds

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Simple pursuit: point at enemy, full throttle unless very close
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)          # -180 .. 180
    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)

    # Turn proportionally, capped
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, bearing / 30.0))

    # Full speed when far, ease off when almost on top of opponent
    forward = 1.0 if dist > 1.0 else 0.7

    left = forward + turn
    right = forward - turn
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)


def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    cmds = []
    flipper = me.weapons.get("front")
    if flipper and flipper["type"] == "flipper":
        ready = flipper.get("ready", False)
        shots = flipper.get("shots_left", 0)

        bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
        dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)

        # Fire when roughly facing enemy, within flipper range, and flipper ready
        if ready and shots > 0 and abs(bearing) < 20 and dist < 0.9:
            cmds.append(flip("front"))
    return cmds
